statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Post-FOMC Tail is easing as the cash-session reversal finished with Nasdaq nearly flat.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; a higher Tail band would require renewed persistent extension or failed retracements with cross-asset confirmation.
headline: Post-FOMC Tail remains WATCH as overnight repricing begins
body: The Fed raised rates 25 bp to 3.75%-4.00%. Nasdaq finished almost flat after a sharp reversal; Treasury yields and the dollar rose, oil fell, and technology outperformed. Live NQ retracement structure was not independently verified at the assessment cutoff.

lookbackSummary: All 24 prior UTC hours are available; Tail ranged 17%-25%, peaking at 25% during late FOMC repricing before easing to 24%.
outlookSummary: Residual FOMC repricing keeps near-term Tail in WATCH, with further overnight decay conditional on two-way trade. Thursday's 12:30 UTC housing, claims and Philadelphia Fed cluster raises Stress and conditional Tail risk ahead of the cash open.

forecast.analysis: Nasdaq closed nearly flat after FOMC whipsaw while yields and the dollar rose and oil fell. With live NQ retracement structure unverified at the cutoff, Tail remains WATCH rather than elevated.
drivers: FOMC delayed second-leg risk remains unresolved
Nasdaq cash close was nearly flat after a sharp reversal
Rising yields and dollar conflict with lower oil and resilient technology

forecastDetail.comment: Post-FOMC whipsaw ended with Nasdaq nearly flat; unverified live NQ structure keeps Tail at WATCH, not elevated.
WATCH decays if Globex trade becomes two-way; renewed shallow-pullback extension would sustain it.
Two-way overnight discovery would move Tail below WATCH; a fresh directional leg would invalidate normalization.
Policy impulse is aging; escalation would require renewed yield/NQ alignment and persistent extension.
Low Tail assumes meaningful Asian-hours pullbacks; repeated failed retracements would restore WATCH.
Balanced discovery keeps Tail low even while policy uncertainty sustains high Stress.
